_spec: Old asset name -> new. null means DROPPED, with the reason. Generated from audit/baseline-14.json and the rebuilt inventory; do not hand-edit (§8.1).
_annotations: OPEN: annotations/ are the ten hand-drawn scrawl marks. They are the only stroke-based assets in the kit and §6 removes the stroke boil they depended on. Rebuilding them as closed flat shapes in the contour colour satisfies rules 1-4 but is a real change in character. Carried by name, not rebuilt; the operator has not been asked.
_rebuiltCheck: built/remaining are measured against emit/manifest.json at generation time, never typed.

stats.note: Targets are ASSET ids (no aspect suffix). roles.fragment.json keys on the SHOT-LIST id, which does carry one. The two differ on purpose and the difference is §4.4a.
